summary: Twelve-room Hollowmere world graph, five abilities, five items and seven enemy archetypes for the metroidvania family.
useWhen: Inspect or extend Hollowmere's authored rooms, item definitions and enemy roster; gameplay policy stays in hollowmere/game.
limitations: Authored content, not a procedural generator. It depends on the family game loader and inventory item registry.
Map coordinates, room rows and ability-gate references are validated but do not prove every route is physically reachable.
